effect: run_touch_bar_command never asks refused_while_locked/lock_waits, so OpenChat opens a chat (and SendSticker sends into the open chat) behind the lock screen; the guard script does not list this entry point either.
fix: Gate run_touch_bar_command on refused_while_locked (drop the command) and list it in scripts/lock-surfaces.txt; empty the bar synchronously in set_locked.

title: Touch commands carry bare ids with no account or screen epoch
trigger: Tap a pinned chat/sticker, or drop a reorder, while an account switch lands between the tap (bar still shows the old account for up to ~33 ms) and the command running.
effect: OpenChat(ChatId), SendSticker(file_id) and ReorderPinned(ids) are applied to the account now on screen: opens an unrelated/missing chat, sends a sticker file id of the other account, or sends a pin order of the other account's chats (TDLib error note).
fix: Stamp each Command with the ScreenEpoch of the Bar it came from (in_screen_scope) and drop it when stale.

title: Failed image decode is cached for the path for the rest of the session
trigger: A pinned chat photo or sticker path is drawn before the file is readable/complete, or the file is later replaced at the same path.
effect: FILES stores Some(None) for the path; file_image returns None from the cache every time, so the pinned chat keeps its initials / the sticker stays blank until 512 other pictures flush the cache.
fix: Cache only successful decodes (or key by path+mtime/size); a miss retries.

title: Touch Bar model is rebuilt on every app notify on Macs without a Touch Bar and while hidden
trigger: Run Quill on any Mac (enabled() only reads the experimental option, not the hardware); keep an animation or poll running.
effect: Every notify schedules a 33 ms timer task that rebuilds the pinned panel (clones titles, photo paths for all pinned chats) and applies it to AppKit, up to 30 times a second, also with the window hidden to the tray.
fix: Skip scheduling when the OS reports no Touch Bar / the window is not visible, and skip apply when the Bar equals the last one applied.

title: TranslateDialog modes are view + Option source + Option job + close_after_choose by hand
trigger: Open Translate from a message, the selection, the bar menu (chooser) or Settings (skip list); switch language, go back, close.
effect: No stuck state found, but the mode is spread over four fields: back_to_box is recomputed as `view==ChooseTo && source.is_some()`, close_after_choose is only meaningful for a ChooseTo with no source, and job is only meaningful for Selection. Each close path must remember to drop the job.
fix: enum TranslateDialog { Translating{source, to, job, expanded}, Choosing{back: Option<Translating>}, SkipList } so each variant carries only its data.

title: A failed selection translation leaves the box on the loading placeholder
trigger: Select text, Translate Selected Text, with the send failing (translate_selection returns Err), or change the language after an earlier job.
effect: request_dialog_translation takes the old job (dropped) and on Err leaves dialog.job = None; dialog_translation then returns None, which the body draws as the grey 'pending' lines, while only a status note says it failed. The box never shows the error text.
fix: Put the job into the dialog stage as Requested(Result<job, error>) and draw Failed for an Err instead of treating no translation as pending.

title: One-slot offer cache thrashes when two windows show different chats
trigger: Main window shows chat A with a translate bar, a chat window shows chat B; both redraw (typing, new messages, animations).
effect: TranslateScreen::offer holds a single (OfferKey, language) keyed by chat; each window's translate_bar_model/translate_offer overwrites it, so every render re-walks the whole loaded history and runs offer_language on all texts. The key also lacks the `automatic` input (chat_auto_translate), so a toggle of automatic translation without a message change keeps a stale answer.
fix: Key the cache by chat (HashMap<ChatId, ..>) and include `automatic`; drop entries for chats no window shows (as pump does).

title: Account switch leaves the open selection translation job in the old session
trigger: Open Translate Selected Text, switch account while the box is open or the answer is pending.
effect: TranslateScreen is dropped with the screen but its Farewell is empty, so drop_text_translation is never sent to the old client: the job stays in that session's translate.jobs (counts toward MAX_IN_FLIGHT for its pump) and texts keeps the result until the process ends.
fix: Implement Farewell for TranslateScreen: drop the dialog's job through the old client.

title: Hiding the translate bar claims success when the request was not sent, and falls back to an app-wide hidden flag by bare chat id
trigger: Bar menu -> Hide while toggle_chat_is_translatable returns Err (no usable client), or the server rejects it.
effect: set_translate_bar_hidden ignores the answer: on Err it stores prefs.bar_hidden(chat_id.0) in the app-wide translate_prefs.json (shared by all accounts, keyed by bare ChatId, so the same user's chat in another account is hidden too), and hide_translate_bar always shows the 'hidden' toast with Undo. On a rejected request the bar stays and the toast lied.
fix: Key local hidden flags by AccountChat and show the toast from the server answer (update chat.is_translatable) rather than from the send.

title: pump_translation reports 'changed' on every tick in a demo session when the bar is no longer offered
trigger: Screenshot demo (live is None): chat is translated and translate_bar_model becomes None (bar hidden, setting off).
effect: The None arm clears chat_to only through self.live, then returns true unconditionally; with no live client chat_to is never cleared, so every poll pass returns true and the poll loop redraws every tick.
fix: Return true only when chat_to actually changed (clear it on demo_session too).

title: Translation pump stops for the whole account if in-flight jobs are never answered
trigger: Twenty translateMessageText requests whose answers are lost (connection drop, dropped continuation).
effect: room = MAX_IN_FLIGHT - session.messages.translate.jobs.len(); jobs leave only when an answer or abandon_translation arrives. Stuck Pending jobs keep room at 0, so translated chats in every window stop translating new messages until restart.
fix: Give a job an expiry/owner (drop jobs of a closed connection) or count only jobs younger than a deadline on a manual clock.

title: PumpScan is key Option + revision + wanted kept in step
trigger: Every pump pass.
effect: key: None means 'never scanned' and the revision/wanted pair is only valid together with that key; record sets all three, but nothing ties the revision to the HistoryMessages instance (correct only because next_revision is process-global).
fix: enum PumpScan { Fresh, Scanned{key, revision, wanted} }.

title: Two-step box stage is open + view + confirm + notice by hand
trigger: Open the 2FA box, go to Recover/Reset/Email forms, close.
effect: open: bool, view: TwofaView, confirm: Option<TwofaConfirm> and notice: Option<String> must change together; goto_twofa_view resets three of them, close_twofa the rest, and the render of the dialog also writes view/confirm (see 13-TMP-021).
fix: enum TwoFaBox { Closed, Open{view: TwofaView, confirm: Option<..>, notice: Option<..>} } with goto/close as the only transitions.

title: A password typed in the Privacy page check card is never cleared when the user leaves
trigger: Privacy page shows the 'Your password' card; type a password without pressing Check, leave the page or close Settings.
effect: close_twofa clears status_check_password but nothing clears check_password (only submit does), so the masked text stays in the field and is back in the card next time the page opens, until an account switch replaces the screen.
fix: Clear check_password in the Privacy page's leave hook (and on close of Settings), as close_twofa does for the box's fields.

title: The 2FA dialog's build closure changes twofa.view and confirm while rendering
trigger: A Recover/LoginEmail step finishes (twofa_step_finished) while the box is open.
effect: build_twofa_dialog writes this.twofa.view = Status and confirm = None during the draw without notifying or clearing the flow's input fields and notice; the state changes in the middle of a frame, other parts of the same frame (footer, notice) were already built from the old view.
fix: Move the step to the place the answer is applied (session apply hook) via goto_twofa_view, and keep render pure.
